name: hydraulic-line
why: Routed tube in a real part: three 90 degree bends of one radius, bored along the same route, with a boss at each end. 19340 mm3 against 19359 by hand, which is the usual 0.1% the tessellation under-reads on curved surfaces. The two-rim selector is what says the bore still runs the whole route — a bend radius that stopped fitting would break the chain and leave a different number.
